item.name: Finanssivalvonta (FIN-FSA, Finnish Financial Supervisory Authority)
item.description: Finland's competent authority under MiCA and the national Act 402/2024 on crypto-asset service providers and crypto-asset markets. Unlike some other countries, Finland had no transitional period; since 1 Jul 2026 crypto services without authorisation are not allowed anywhere in the EU/EEA (FIN-FSA, 30 Jun 2026).

sources.title: Crypto-asset service providers in Finland must be authorised in the EU
Act 402/2024 on crypto-asset service providers and crypto-asset markets
